titulo.alumno: «Aquilo que ainda falta»: what is still missing

intro: Read the text and interpret «aquilo que» and «o que» as a reference to an idea or situation.

palabras.significado: In context: What worries the residents most is the noise at night.
In context: What the council can do is still under discussion.
In context: The public meeting will be next week.

texto: Interpret «aquilo que» and «o que» as a reference to an idea or situation.
Compare the literal information with the purpose of the text; don't add details that don't appear.
